_comment: Generic destroyed-this-turn tracking: this read AURA_DESTROYED_THIS_TURN, a flag nothing ever set. effect_keywords.destroy now records "destroyed_this_turn:<slug|type|subtype>" and DESTROYED_THIS_TURN reads it by name. The first clause was BANISH_TRAP_FROM_GRAVEYARD_PLAYABLE -- a different effect on a different card type in a different zone, which also made the card playable from banish. The text is "you may SHUFFLE an INSTANT card from your graveyard INTO YOUR DECK"; SEARCH_GRAVEYARD is already the may-fail-to-find search and now takes a destination.
